audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: Sylas wins every stage per packet and content; Syndra is immobile, her only lockdown is Scatter the Weak, and Sylas dives her once it is down. Her threat is scaling sphere stacks into Unleashed Power.
Spikes accurate: level 3 brawl window, 6 Hijack of Unleashed Power, first item all-in; her spike is stacked-sphere R late. Both chart layers agree on Sylas all seven rows and match the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen lint defects: 13 misgendered fields (Syndra is she/her), two copy-paste bleeds in dos/donts, and breakdown.cooldowns with no digits.
audit.why: Kit facts: Scatter the Weak is 15s flat and her only hard CC; Q Dark Sphere is 7s; her R is 120/100/80 vs Sylas Hijack 80/55/30; W and P deal true damage so resistances do not answer her (missing-interactions rule). Sylas E is 13s at rank 1 and is the scatter-dodge.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed, bleeds replaced with grounded cooldown advice, cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers.
